<style>#partner_big_banner {

  margin: 0.3125vw auto 0;

#partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 27.078125vw;
  border-radius: 1.25vw;

}

.grid_simplicity_item:hover {
  box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 5px 5px 20px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 2px 6px 6px;

}

#partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item .grid_simplicity_item_info {
  left: 3.59375vw;
  bottom: 1.828125vw;
  top: auto;
  transform: none;
}

#partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) {
  width: calc((100% - 2.90625vw) / 3) !important;
  height: 20.828125vw;
}

#partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) .grid_simplicity_item_info {
  left: 0;
  transform: none;
  bottom: 1.515625vw;
  top: auto;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
}

#partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) .grid_simplicity_item_btns {
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: center;
}

#partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) .grid_simplicity_item_title {
  display: none;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 768px) {
  #partner_big_banner {
    padding: 13.6vw 5.33vw;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_title {
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 40px;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_text {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 22px;
    margin-top: 3.2vw;
    width: 100%;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_contain {
    margin-top: 9.6vw;
    gap: 4.8vw;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item {
    height: 64vw !important;
    border-radius: 3.2vw;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) {
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) .grid_simplicity_item_title {
    display: block;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item .grid_simplicity_item_info {
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) .grid_simplicity_item_info {
    padding: 0 5.33vw;
  }

  #partner_big_banner .grid_simplicity_item:nth-child(n+5) .grid_simplicity_item_btns {
    justify-content: flex-start;
